name: Queen’s Croquet Game
summary: 王后槌球赛是红心王后命令众人用活火烈鸟和刺猬进行的古怪比赛，爱丽丝也被卷入其中。[1][2][3]

sections.title: 古怪的场地
sections.text: 比赛在红心王后的槌球场上进行。爱丽丝觉得这是她见过的最奇怪的槌球场：地面全是垄沟，球是活刺猬，槌棒是活火烈鸟，而拱门则由士兵们弯腰手脚撑地来充当。[1]

sections.title: 王后发令
sections.text: 红心王后一声雷鸣般的喊叫“各就各位！”，人们立刻四处乱跑，互相撞倒，但一两分钟后便安顿下来，比赛开始。[2][4][5][6]

sections.title: 爱丽丝加入
sections.text: 王后吼道“那就来吧！”，爱丽丝便加入了队伍，心里非常想知道接下来会发生什么。[3]

citations.relation: Queen’s Croquet Game 发生于 Queen’s Croquet-Ground
citations.evidence_text: Alice thought she had never seen such a curious croquet-ground in her life; it was all ridges and furrows; the balls were live hedgehogs, the mallets live flamingoes, and the soldiers had to double themselves up and to stand on their hands and feet, to make the arches.

citations.relation: Queen of Hearts 参与 Queen’s Croquet Game
citations.evidence_text: “Get to your places!” shouted the Queen in a voice of thunder, and people began running about in all directions, tumbling up against each other; however, they got settled down in a minute or two, and the game began.

citations.relation: Alice 参与 Queen’s Croquet Game
citations.evidence_text: “Come on, then!” roared the Queen, and Alice joined the procession, wondering very much what would happen next.
